purpose: The service written in ServiceTutorial.md: one stateless check, routed on a string result. Physical placement is defined separately by the service deployment.

services.description: Approves a credit application up to a limit of 5,000 and refers the rest. Application n asks for n x 1,000 unless the token carries an amount.
services.returns: A credit decision with the application, amount and limit. Routes on "approve" (within the limit) or "refer" (over it).

services.description: It validates the attributes and details of the application
